t001.sum: The Universal Father is God, the First Source and Center of all things and beings. He is the Creator, the Controller, and the infinite Upholder; though an invisible spirit, he is a true personality who loves all his creatures as a father. Because his fragment, the Thought Adjuster, indwells man, anyone may set out on the eternal adventure of finding the Father and becoming like him.
t001.s1.i1: The Father is the God of all creation, the First Source and Center of all things and beings, to be thought of first as Creator, then as Controller, and lastly as infinite Upholder.
t001.s1.i2: The Father personally created Paradise and the central universe, while the universes of time and space are made by the Creator Sons; Nebadon is the creation of his Son Michael.
t001.s1.i3: The Father functions physically through the gravity of the Paradise Isle, mentally in the Infinite Spirit, and spiritually in the Eternal Son, yet he maintains direct contact with his creatures.
t001.s1.i5: With God there is no separate past, present, and future; all time is present, and no universe event ever comes to him as a surprise.
t001.s2.i1: The First Source and Center has never revealed a name for himself; the name "Father" grew out of the personal relationship his creatures have with him.
t001.s2.i2: The name by which he is called matters little; what matters is the desire to know him and to be like him.
t001.s2.i3: God is a transcendent reality infinitely greater than any idealized reality, personified law of nature, or "man's highest product."
t001.s2.i4: The existence of God cannot be proved by scientific experiment or pure logic; it is realized only within the realm of human experience.
t001.s3.i2: The Father is invisible not because he hides himself, but because material beings could not preserve their existence before his spiritual brilliance; yet he can be discerned with the eye of faith.
t001.s3.i3: His infinity should not obscure his personality; the Father is the acme of divine personality, the origin and destiny of all personality.
t001.s3.i4: In the local universe the Father is revealed in the personalities of the Creator Sons, so that he who has seen the Son has seen the Father.
t001.s4.i2: The Father's love was not won by the sacrifice or intercession of his Sons; he loves his children personally from the beginning.
t001.s4.i3: The Hebrew prophets proclaimed God as the Father of Israel, but Jesus revealed him as the Father of each human being.
t001.s4.i4: The Father personally participates in the struggle of every soul striving toward perfection, suffering in our afflictions and triumphing in our victories.
t001.s4.i5: God the Father loves mankind, God the Son ministers to mankind, and God the Spirit inspires his children to ascend in search of the Father.
t001.s5.i1: The Father requires no formal worship or slavish service; the wholehearted dedication of doing the Father's will is the only truly personal gift man can offer.
t001.s5.i3: Man cannot approach the Father directly not because he is far away but because of creature finiteness, and the way is open to all.
t001.s5.i5: However different their intellectual and social status, all men have received the same divine presence, so the possibility of spiritual progress is equal for everyone.
t001.s5.i6: However long it takes, the ascender fused with the Adjuster will one day stand before the divine center and see the Father face to face.
t002.sum: The attributes of God show how the infinite Father relates to his creation. He is everywhere present, all-powerful, and all-knowing. He bestows himself without stint yet is in no way diminished, and he rules through his Sons while reserving final sovereignty to himself. All these attributes are unified and co-ordinated in love and wisdom, justice and mercy.
t002.s1.i1: Creativity is not so much an attribute as the whole of God's active nature, culminating in the truth of the fatherhood of God.
t002.s1.i2: Only God can be in innumerable places at the same time; he is present in all parts of his creation and in all hearts.
t002.s1.i4: God is fully discernibly present only on Paradise and in the central universe; in the outer creations he limits his direct presence out of respect for the sovereignty of his co-ordinate creators.
t002.s1.i5: The effective presence of the Father in man is determined by the degree to which his mind co-operates with the indwelling Adjuster.
t002.s2.i1: The long evolution of races, planets, and universes unfolds in orderly fashion according to the Father's eternal purpose, under the control of the creators.
t002.s2.i2: Viewed as nonspiritual phenomena, God is energy; all physical energy proceeds from him and is held within the gravity control of nether Paradise.
t002.s2.i4: God's acts sometimes appear heartless only because of finite vision; all of them aim at the highest good of everyone concerned.
t002.s2.i5: God's power is limited only by his nature (love, truth, beauty, and goodness), by his will (mercy), and by his law (the justice of the Trinity).
t002.s3.i1: God is conscious of the thoughts of all creation and is the only personality who actually knows the number of the stars and planets of space.
t002.s3.i2: His knowledge is supplemented through the personality circuit embracing all personalities, through the descending divine Sons, and through the indwelling Thought Adjusters.
t002.s3.i3: Even if God should foreknow the freewill acts of his children, such foreknowledge in no way abrogates their freedom.
t002.s3.i5: Omnipotence does not imply the power to do the ungodlike, and omniscience does not mean knowing the unknowable.
t002.s4.i1: Having bestowed himself without stint upon his Sons and his creation, the Father is in no way diminished in his potential of power, wisdom, and love.
t002.s4.i2: Even if creation should go on endlessly, the controlling power of Paradise would be ample, and the Infinite would still be filled with the same force and energy.
t002.s4.i3: Man cannot fully conceive the Father's infinity but can truly experience the impact of his love; the quality of that experience is unlimited, while its quantity depends on spiritual capacity.
t002.s5.i1: Outside Havona the Father exercises his power through his Sons and their subordinate personalities, acting directly only when a delegated agent fails in his trust.
t002.s5.i2: In the hearts of men the Father's will may not always be done, but in the course and destiny of a planet the divine plan prevails.
t002.s5.i3: Adversity, inequality, uncertainty, and the possibility of error are conditions of life needed to develop such qualities as courage, unselfishness, hope, and faith.
t002.s5.i4: The Father delegates authority freely, but reserves to himself the final decision and veto concerning the welfare and destiny of creation.
t002.s6.i1: The plans and purposes of the First Source and Center are, like himself, eternal, perfect, and changeless; though they may appear to change, the underlying purpose is unchanging.
t002.s6.i2: The Father's justice does not depend on the conduct of his creatures, and even when he lets them reap the results of wrongdoing it is always tempered by mercy.
t002.s6.i4: Because of his infinite wisdom God bestows justice and mercy at the same time and is never torn by conflicting attitudes toward his children.
t003.sum: The Universal Father is infinite yet a true personality. Personality is not one attribute among many but the way the totality of his infinite nature and unified will is revealed. The personality of every creature is bestowed by the Father and upheld in his personality circuit, and because God is personal, man can commune with him, love him, and become his friend.
t003.s1.i2: God far transcends any concept of personality man can grasp, yet he cannot be anything less than an eternal, true, good, and beautiful personality.
t003.s1.i3: Without God and his central personality there would be no personality anywhere in the vast universe.
t003.s1.i4: Personality is not an attribute of God but the totality of his co-ordinated infinite nature and unified divine will, God's revelation to the universe of universes.
t003.s1.i5: God is more than power, energy, pattern, or presence; he is a personality who exercises sovereign will, experiences the self-consciousness of divinity, and reveals a father's love to his children.
t003.s2.i2: Personality does not require a material body; because of this error materialism denies the personality of the dead, and pantheism the personality of a bodiless God.
t003.s2.i3: Denying the personality of the First Source and Center leaves only the two philosophic dilemmas of materialism and pantheism.
t003.s2.i4: Reason, wisdom, and religious experience imply God's personality but do not prove it; this concept came to mankind chiefly through revelation.
t003.s2.i6: Man views the infinite from the finite, and God views the finite from the infinite; so the concept of divine personality improves as man's understanding of human personality improves.
t003.s3.i1: The Father is the bestower and conservator of all personality, from the lowest mortal to the highest creator, and the destiny of every finite personality who chooses his will.
t003.s3.i2: Mind, spirit, or physical energy alone is not personality; personality is the endowment the Father exclusively bestows upon living systems of matter, mind, and spirit.
t003.s3.i4: Just as all gravity is linked to the Paradise Isle, mind to the Conjoint Actor, and spirit to the Eternal Son, so all personality is linked to the Father's personality circuit.
t003.s3.i5: Apart from the mission of the Adjusters, the Father is personally conscious of, and in contact with, personalities on all levels of self-conscious existence.
t003.s4.i1: In bestowing personality upon a creature, the Father also bestows a relative freedom from slavish response to antecedent causation.
t003.s4.i2: Having provided for the growth of the soul, the Father withdraws, and he has decreed as an absolute law the sovereignty of the mortal will concerning eternal survival.
t003.s5.i1: Among impersonal things there is only interaction; fellowship such as that of father and son can be enjoyed only when both are personalities.
t003.s5.i3: Truth and beauty may be conceived apart from personality, but divine goodness is understood only in relation to personality, and only a personality can love and be loved.
t003.s5.i4: Because God can know and be known, love and be loved, man too can be known as the friend of God.
t003.s5.i5: Jesus fully realized the potential of spirit personality in human experience, so his life is the most practical revelation of the personality of God.
t003.s5.i6: If man fails to see the love of a personal God, the kingdom of God becomes merely the kingdom of good.
t004.sum: The Eternal Son is the Second Source and Center, the perfect expression of the Universal Father's first personal and absolute concept. He is the living divine Word, the final revelation of the Father's spirit and personality, and the spiritual administrator who holds all spirit reality in the spirit-gravity circuit. Extending the Father's love as mercy, he draws near to creatures through the bestowals of the Paradise Sons.
t004.s1.i1: The Eternal Son is the complete expression of the Father's first personal and absolute concept; whenever the Father expresses himself personally, he does so through the Son.
t004.s1.i2: The phrase "first thought" is only a concession to time-bound minds; the Son has no beginning and is coeternal with the Father.
t004.s1.i4: The Father never functions personally as a creator except in conjunction with the Son or with the co-ordinate action of the Son.
t004.s1.i5: On Urantia the Original Son has been confused with the bestowal Son, Michael of Nebadon, but the title "Eternal Son" belongs to the Original Son alone.
t004.s2.i1: The Son is as changeless and infinitely trustworthy as the Father, and to us he seems more personal, being one step nearer to approach.
t004.s2.i3: The Son is not an intercessor pleading with the Father for mercy; every mercy the Son shows is a direct revelation of the Father's love.
t004.s2.i4: Mercy is applied love; by analogy, the love of God is more like a father's love, while the love of the Eternal Son is more like a mother's affection.
t004.s2.i5: The Father loves his universe children as a father, while the Eternal Son looks upon every creature as both father and brother.
t004.s3.i1: The Son is omnipotent only in the spiritual realm; he does not function personally in the physical domains or in mind ministry apart from the Conjoint Actor.
t004.s3.i2: Spirit gravity is free from time lag, undiminished by space, and does not decrease with the square of the distance.
t004.s3.i3: Spiritual realities respond to spirit gravity according to their qualitative value, and that response is as dependable and predictable as the response of matter to gravity.
t004.s4.h: Prayer and Relation to the Individual
t004.s4.i1: The spirit of the Eternal Son surrounds us, but it does not indwell us or become part of us as the Mystery Monitor does.
t004.s4.i2: The spiritual content of sincere prayer is instantly conveyed over the spirit-gravity circuit to every divine personality concerned.
t004.s4.i3: Purely material and self-centered petitions cannot enter the spirit circuit and fall dead.
t004.s5.i1: The Son accepted without reservation the Father's plan of progressive attainment, and he himself proposed the bestowal plan of sending the Sons of God to the evolutionary worlds.
t004.s5.i2: The Eternal Son is the personal trustee and divine guardian of the plan of creature ascension that the Father committed to him.
t004.s5.i3: Since the Son's personality cannot be fragmented, he participates in creature experience through the incarnations of the Paradise Sons.
t004.s5.i4: The Eternal Son bestowed himself seven times upon the seven circuits of Havona, a fact that is an eternal encouragement to every pilgrim passing through Havona.
t004.s6.i1: The Eternal Son is the complete and final revelation of the Father's spirit and personality, and all knowledge of the Father comes from the Son and his Sons.
t004.s6.i2: The Father draws near to us as a personality only through the divine Sons of the Eternal Son, and through that living way we too ascend to the Father.
t004.s6.i3: Pilgrims passing through the Havona circuits are able to reach the Son long before they are prepared to discern the Father.
t004.s6.i4: The Son's personality does not shine brightly to the material or morontia mind; only as spirit ascension begins does it become increasingly real.
t005.sum: The Infinite Spirit is the third person of Deity, the Conjoint Actor and Conjoint Creator, who came into existence the moment the Father and the Son conceived one united action. As the executive of the Father-Son partnership he is the source of mind, the manipulator of energy, and the omnipresent spirit who bestows the Father's love and the Son's mercy on all creatures. His many spirit children form the living ladder by which mortals climb to Paradise.
t005.s1.i1: In the very moment when the Father and the Son together conceived one infinite action, the execution of an absolute thought-plan, the Infinite Spirit sprang into complete existence.
t005.s1.i2: This order of origin is only an explanation to aid human understanding; all three have existed from eternity, without beginning or end.
t005.s1.i3: The Infinite Spirit pledged eternal allegiance to the Father and acknowledged eternal dependence on the Son, and thereby the Paradise Trinity came into existence.
t005.s1.i4: The Infinite Spirit became eternalized with the birth of the central universe of Havona, and through this conjoint creative act he became the eternal Conjoint Creator.
t005.s2.i1: He is known by many names, among them the Universal Spirit, the Conjoint Creator, the Infinite Mind, the Spirit of Spirits, and the Conjoint Actor, and on Urantia he is sometimes confused with cosmic mind.
t005.s2.i2: The Infinite Spirit shares the Father's perfection, righteousness, and love, yet inclines toward the mercy of the Eternal Son, becoming the mercy minister of the Paradise Deities.
t005.s2.i3: After the personalization of the Third Source, the Father no longer personally participates in universe creation; he commits all he can to the Son, and the Son in turn to the Conjoint Creator.
t005.s2.i5: The Infinite Spirit is the first Paradise Deity reached by the ascending pilgrims at the center of all things.
t005.s3.i2: In the local universe, through the Mother Spirit, his Creative Daughter, he joins the Creator Son in fostering the spiritual ascent of material creatures.
t005.s3.i3: The Spirit does not descend in the flesh, but he gladly undergoes a series of divinity attenuations until at last he stands beside us as the angels to guide us on our earthly way.
t005.s3.i4: Our universe is shaped between the anvil of justice and the hammer of suffering, but those who wield the hammer are the beings of mercy, the children of the Infinite Spirit.
t005.s3.i5: The spirit personalities of the Infinite Spirit form the living ladder by which mortal man climbs from chaos to glory.
t005.s4.i1: The outstanding attribute of the Infinite Spirit is omnipresence; he shares the Father's omniscience but is omnipotent only in the domain of mind.
t005.s4.i2: The Holy Spirit is the distinctive spiritual circuit that the Creative Daughter of the Infinite Spirit spreads over each local universe, while the Infinite Spirit himself is everywhere present.
t005.s4.i4: Though different in origin, the Adjuster, the spirit of the Eternal Son, and the presence of the Infinite Spirit co-operate perfectly in man's mind and soul, working as one spirit.
t005.s5.h: Manipulator of Energy and Absolute Mind
t005.s5.i1: The Conjoint Creator is not energy itself but the manipulator of energy, possessing the power of antigravity, which is not observed in either the Father or the Son.
t005.s5.i3: Creature mind originates solely in the Third Source, and not even a fragment of the Father can indwell man until the Infinite Spirit has prepared the way of mind.
t005.s5.i4: That the source of mind is divine does not make every mind phenomenon divine; human intellect is rooted in animal origins.
t005.s5.i5: As the Father draws all personality and the Son all spirit, so the Conjoint Actor draws all mind through the mind-gravity circuit.
t005.s6.i1: The Infinite Spirit is a universe presence, a power, and the universal mind, and more, yet he is at the same time a true and divine personality.
t005.s6.i2: The Infinite Spirit has will as well as mind; his love and sorrows are real, and he reacts to the universe as a person.
t005.s6.i4: In the Infinite Spirit the Father and the Son are mutually present, always in unqualified perfection.
t006.sum: The Paradise Trinity is the indivisible Deity union of three co-ordinate persons: the Father, the Son, and the Spirit. The Trinity is not itself a personality, yet it is a true and absolute reality whose functions are more than the sum of the attributes of the three persons. It administers justice and exercises overcontrol of the totality in the universes, and it is the only inevitable fact of the universe, the one that liberates the Father from personality absolutism so that he can bestow himself without stint.
t006.s1.i1: The Trinity unites the expression of God's infinite personal will with the absoluteness of Deity, freeing the Father from the limitations of personality absolutism.
t006.s1.i3: The Father has passed on to his Sons all the power and authority that can be delegated; divine personality is not self-centered and delights in sharing.
t006.s1.i4: By bestowing absolute personality upon the Son, the Father became the Father of the Son, and the Father and the Son together bestowed conjoint personality upon the Infinite Spirit.
t006.s2.i2: Each of the three is original, none a duplicate of another, and yet all are united.
t006.s2.i3: Only the Eternal Son experiences both sonship toward the Father and fatherhood toward the Spirit, and so knows the fullness of divine personality relationship.
t006.s2.i5: Fatherhood is not real without sonship, and the Father has never existed alone without the Son and the Spirit.
t006.s2.i6: Outside Havona the Father works through the Creator Sons, gravity, the Son, the Conjoint Creator, the personality circuit, and the Adjusters, and as total Deity he functions only in the Trinity.
t006.s3.h: A True Reality, Not a Personality
t006.s3.i1: The Trinity is an association of infinite persons functioning in an impersonal capacity yet not out of keeping with personality, comparable to a corporation acting on the personal will of its members.
t006.s3.i3: The three Deities as individuals may co-operate as they choose, but such co-operation is not the Trinity.
t006.s3.i4: Just as the potential of a group exceeds the sum of its members' attributes, so the functions of the Trinity are more than the simple sum of the attributes of the three Deities.
t006.s3.i5: There are many existential triunities but only one existential Trinity; the Trinity is not a functional association but undivided Deity.
t006.s4.i1: Law issues from the Father, the administration of spiritual law rests with the Son, the revelation of law with the Spirit, and justice, the application of law, belongs to the Trinity.
t006.s4.i3: Stationary Sons of the Trinity, such as the Ancients of Days, administer the judgments of the superuniverses on the evidence presented by personalities of the Infinite Spirit.
t006.s4.i4: Justice is the collective thought of righteousness, and mercy is its personal expression; when fully understood, the justice of the Trinity and the love of the Father coincide.
t006.s4.i5: Toward the finite the Trinity acts as the Trinity of Supremacy, and toward the absonite as the Trinity of Ultimacy.
t006.s4.i6: Even catastrophes and inexplicable changes in life may be woven into a meaningful pattern through the functions of the Supreme and the overcontrol of the Trinity.
t006.s5.i1: The triune deity concepts of evolutionary religion arose from natural associations such as the joints of a finger or a three-legged stool, and they must be distinguished from the revealed concept of the Trinity.
t006.s5.i3: On Urantia the Trinity was presented successively by the staff of Caligastia, by Adam and Eve, and by Machiventa Melchizedek.
t006.s5.i4: The Christian concept of the Trinity, though in error as to fact, was practically true with respect to spiritual relationships.
t006.s5.i5: A personal Deity requires relationship with other equal personalities; a concept of Deity without such relationship readily shrinks to a pantheistic absolute.
t006.s5.i6: Recognition of the Trinity concept makes possible some understanding of the interrelation of love and law in the creations of time and space.
t007.sum: God the Sevenfold is the sevenfold Deity association provided by the Universal Father so that finite creatures can approach Deity. It extends from the Creator Son of the local universe through the Ancients of Days, the Seven Master Spirits, the Supreme Being, the Infinite Spirit, and the Eternal Son to the Universal Father, and ascending mortals discover Deity experientially in this order. Its first three levels are also the source of the almighty power of the Supreme Being.
t007.s1.i1: To compensate for the limitations of finite status and concept, the Universal Father established the sevenfold approach of evolutionary creatures to Deity.
t007.s1.i2: The seven levels are the Paradise Creator Sons, the Ancients of Days, the Seven Master Spirits, the Supreme Being, God the Spirit, God the Son, and God the Father.
t007.s1.i4: The experiential career of finding God begins with recognizing the divinity of the local universe Creator Son and proceeds through the Ancients of Days and the Master Spirits to the Paradise Father.
t007.s1.i5: God the Sevenfold is the Deity actually functioning for evolutionary mortals in the Paradise-ascension career.
t007.s2.i1: Of the seven levels the first three are the Supreme Creators and the last three the Paradise Deities, with the Supreme Being ever intervening between them.
t007.s2.i2: Paradise Deity attenuated and qualified divinity personalization outside Paradise to bring the Supreme Creators into being, and they carry the light of life to the evolutionary worlds.
t007.s2.i3: The combined acts of the first three levels do not equal Paradise Deity; they constitute a new power potential of experiential Deity.
t007.s2.i5: The divinity ministry of the Sevenfold reaches inward through the Eternal Son to the Paradise Father and outward through the Ancients of Days to the Creator Sons.
t007.s3.i1: God the Supreme derives his personality and spirit attributes from the Trinity, but his power is actualized in the doings of the Creator Sons, the Ancients of Days, and the Master Spirits.
t007.s3.i2: God the Supreme is manifested to evolutionary creatures as a personality of power only when the first three levels of God the Sevenfold function in co-ordination.
t007.s3.i4: In mortal experience the Supreme Being is the unifier of God the Sevenfold, the maximum of Deity that finite creatures can actually comprehend.
t007.s3.i5: The various aspects of sevenfold Deity are now integrated in various ways, but all are destined to be unified in Supremacy.
t007.s4.h: The Sevenfold Controllers and Cosmic Function
t007.s4.i1: God the Sevenfold includes not only the creators but also the sevenfold controllers of the grand universe, such as the Master Physical Controllers, the Supreme Power Centers, and the Supreme Power Directors.
t007.s4.i2: The council of the Seven Master Spirits seems to co-ordinate the far-flung activities of God the Sevenfold, and it also contributes to the final level, the union of the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit.
t007.s4.i5: Through the ministry of God the Sevenfold the imperfect is linked with the perfect in the time lag, and the creature becomes a partner of the Creator in his own evolution.
t007.s4.i6: The power arising from the achievements of God the Sevenfold is experiential power, earned and demonstrated, in contrast to the existential power of the Paradise Deities.
t007.s5.i1: The evolution of time and space begins on planets presided over by the union of the Creator Son and the Creative Spirit, the first manifestation of God the Sevenfold, and as a local universe is settled God the Sevenfold is more clearly revealed.
t007.s5.i2: As the creations are settled, the first three manifestations recede and a fuller activity of God the Supreme appears, but what follows has not yet been revealed.
t007.s5.i4: The worlds of light and life successively grasp the reality of God the Sevenfold, from adoration of the Creator Son to worship of the Paradise Father.
t007.s5.i5: Whatever Deity level is attained, the ascender each time rediscovers the Paradise Father of all personalities on a new level of experience.
t008.sum: The Supreme Being is the experiential Deity evolving in time and space. He derives his spirit personality from the Paradise Trinity and his almighty power from the first three levels of God the Sevenfold, and these two are being unified in the Supreme Mind. As the oversoul of the grand universe and the sum of finite reality, he registers the experience of every creature and creator, and he is actualized one step further whenever man does the will of God.
t008.s1.i1: The Father, the Son, and the Spirit are existential Deities, while God the Supreme, God the Ultimate, and God the Absolute are experiential Deities becoming actual in the post-Havona evolution of the universes.
t008.s1.i3: Havona does not grow but simply is, whereas growth is the mark of the grand universe and the sign of experiential Deity.
t008.s1.i4: The Supreme Being functions as a spirit personality in the central universe and as God the Almighty, a personality of power, in the grand universe.
t008.s1.i5: The destiny of the Supreme is perfection, but his present experience contains elements of growth and incompleteness.
t008.s2.h: Origins: The Trinity and God the Sevenfold
t008.s2.i1: The spirit personality of the Supreme comes from the Paradise Trinity, and his growth derives from the two triunities of actuality and potentiality.
t008.s2.i2: The power of the Almighty rests on the divinity successes of God the Sevenfold, and the Conjoint Actor bestows the mind of Supremacy that joins power and spirit personality.
t008.s2.i3: The Supreme Being is absolutely dependent on the Paradise Trinity for the reality of his personal and spiritual nature.
t008.s2.i4: God the Supreme is not only evolved by the creators and derived from the Trinity; he is also a volitional being who himself participates in his own actualization.
t008.s3.i2: In the Supreme Being Creator and creature are unified in one Deity, whose will is something greater than the will of either creator or creature.
t008.s3.i3: He is the finite synthesis of the experience of the creators who descend to reveal God and of the creatures who ascend in search of God.
t008.s3.i4: The personality of a nonsurvivor is absorbed into the oversoul of creation, returning to the Supreme as a drop of water returns to the sea.
t008.s3.i5: Man does not lose his personal identity in unification with the Supreme, and the echoes of all his experiences become part of the experience of the Supreme.
t008.s3.i6: The grand universe is a magnificently responsive living organism, permeated by intelligence circuits and energy channels.
t008.s4.h: The Interdependence of Man and the Supreme
t008.s4.i1: To the extent that we do the will of God anywhere, the almighty potential of the Supreme becomes one step more actual.
t008.s4.i2: The creature cannot evolve without the Supreme, nor can the evolution of the Supreme be completed without the full evolution of all creatures.
t008.s4.i3: This relationship of man and the Supreme is the foundation of cosmic morality, which recognizes experiential obligation to experiential Deity.
t008.s4.i5: As we seek the Father, the Supreme also seeks, in us and with us, the Paradise Creator of all things.
t008.s5.h: The Way to Find the Supreme
t008.s5.i1: As God is the divine Father, the Supreme is the divine Mother, in whom we are nurtured throughout our universe careers.
t008.s5.i3: The Father can be found by each individual, but the Supreme will not be found individually until the far future, when all creatures together attain cosmic maturity and find him.
t008.s5.i4: The Father's love becomes real only as it is bestowed on one's fellows, and brotherly affection flowing in this way is the essence of the love of the Supreme.
t008.s5.i5: Man discovers the Supreme not suddenly, as an earthquake strikes, but slowly and patiently, as a river wears away the soil.
t008.s5.i7: The God-knowing mortal is never lonely; the Father accompanies him all the way, and the very path he walks is the presence of the Supreme.
t008.s6.i1: When the grand universe is settled in light and life, spirit personality and almighty power will be unified in the Supreme Mind, and the Supreme Being will be factualized as completed actuality.
t008.s6.i2: It is believed that the Supreme will then become the actual sovereign of the grand universe and that the distinctions among the seven superuniverses will gradually disappear.
t008.s6.i3: The citizens of the perfected universe will then face a new challenge, the quest for God the Ultimate.
t009.sum: God the Ultimate is the second experiential Deity, eventuating after the Supreme Being, a transcendental power-personality functioning on the absonite level that transcends the time and space of the master universe. He eventuates from the unification of the Ultimate Trinity, to be composed of the Supreme Creators, the Supreme Being, and the Architects of the Master Universe, and his full emergence signifies the completion of the master universe creation. He is the object of the next quest for the finaliters and the perfected citizens once the grand universe is settled in light and life.
t009.s1.i2: Absonite realities are things and beings that are eventuated rather than created, without beginning or end and transcending time and space, and the function of Deity in relation to them is Ultimacy.
t009.s1.i4: Among the seven natures of Deity, Supremacy is the evolutionary-experiential self and Ultimacy the transcendental-experiential self.
t009.s1.i5: God the Ultimate transcends time and space and is capable of functional association with the Absolutes, yet he is absonite.
t009.s2.i2: The Supreme and the Ultimate complement each other in the attainment of destiny, forming the experiential bridge linking the beginnings and completions of all creative growth in the master universe.
t009.s2.i3: Ultimacy and Supremacy are comparable but not identical, nor is Ultimacy merely an enlargement of Supremacy.
t009.s2.i4: As the Supreme Being evolves from the potentials of the grand universe, God the Ultimate eventuates from the divinity potentials in the time- and space-transcended domains of the master universe.
t009.s2.i5: When God the Supreme comes to rule the universes of time and space directly, that administration will function under the overcontrol of Ultimacy, and God the Ultimate will begin to appear as the transcendental Almighty.
t009.s3.i1: The Ultimate Trinity is the Deity association of the Supreme Creators, God the Supreme, and the Architects of the Master Universe, and it is now evolving.
t009.s3.i3: When the present universe age ends and the Almighty Supreme emerges, the first experiential Trinity will function fully and further integrate the evolution of the master creation.
t009.s3.i4: This Trinity includes the Master Creator Sons, so that actual creature experience is embraced in its association.
t009.s3.i6: The unification of the master universe is the eventuating act of the Ultimate and is thought to reflect some phase of the absonite overcontrol of the Paradise Trinity.
t009.s4.i1: As the Supreme is spiritually and personally present in Havona, so Ultimacy exists there in an absonite and superpersonal sense.
t009.s4.i2: Qualified vicegerents of the Ultimate are known to exist already, but their present location and function have not been revealed.
t009.s4.i3: God the Ultimate foreshadows his transcendental overcontrol in the later stages of local universes settled in light and life.
t009.s4.i4: Mortals who reach the seventh stage of light and life, while coming to know God the Supreme, dimly discern the pervasive ministry of God the Ultimate.
t009.s4.i5: The "eventuation of universe capacity," which turns undifferentiated potential into defined universe plans, is the activity of Ultimacy and the transcendental agencies.
t009.s5.h: The Next Goal of the Finaliters
t009.s5.i1: Ascenders find God the Supreme in Havona, and after becoming finaliters they attempt to know him as Ultimacy.
t009.s5.i2: When the truth, beauty, and goodness of the Supreme Being have fully permeated them, the absonite qualities of ultimate divinity beyond that conceptual level open before progressing creatures.
t009.s5.i3: God the Ultimate is provided to offer a destiny of ultimate service to all creatures who reach absonite levels through the ministry of God the Sevenfold.
t009.s5.i5: For finaliters who have attained Ultimacy the remaining path is the quest for the Absolute, and they know that at its end they will find the same Paradise Father.
t009.s5.i6: God the Supreme and God the Ultimate are Deities eternal only in the future and not in the past, having a beginning of personality but no ending.
t010.sum: The Three Absolutes are the Absolutes of potentiality: the Deity Absolute, the Unqualified Absolute, and the Universal Absolute. The Deity Absolute is the totality of all Deity potential; the Unqualified Absolute is the finality of undeified reality and of all impersonal potential; and the Universal Absolute unifies and co-ordinates the two. They exist eternally together with the differentiation of reality made by the Father's free will, and they are the cosmic foundation that makes it possible for finite universes and personalities to coexist with the Infinite.
t010.s1.h: The Differentiation of Reality and the Three Absolutes
t010.s1.i1: Total infinite reality exists in seven co-ordinate Absolutes, three of which are the Deity Absolute, the Universal Absolute, and the Unqualified Absolute.
t010.s1.i2: The Universal Absolute resolves the primal tension that arose when the Father by free will divided reality into the deified and the undeified.
t010.s1.i3: When Havona was created, the Father separated its presence from infinite potential, and this potential is concealed in the Unqualified Absolute and encompassed by the Deity Absolute.
t010.s1.i5: On subinfinite levels the three Absolutes exist separately, but in infinity they appear to be one.
t010.s2.i1: The Deity Absolute is the causational, potentially personal possibilities of universal reality, the totality of all Deity potential.
t010.s2.i3: The Deity Absolute never seems to react subabsolutely to any situation, but always appears to react in terms of the welfare of all creation and of all future eternity.
t010.s2.i4: Existential spirit values find their origin and destiny in the triunity of the Universal Father, the Son-Spirit, and the Deity Absolute.
t010.s2.i5: The Eternal Son dominates actual spirit values, while the Deity Absolute seems to pervade the vast domain of spirit values that are still potential.
t010.s2.i6: God the Absolute now exists as the Deity Absolute, and it is postulated that he may become experientially personalized through the function of the Absolute Trinity.
t010.s3.i1: The Unqualified Absolute is nonpersonal and nondivine, and neither fact, truth, experience, nor revelation can penetrate its nature.
t010.s3.i3: It is not a vague influence like a pantheistic concept or the ether hypothesis of older science, but an actual presence pervading the grand universe and the space beyond.
t010.s3.i4: The Unqualified Absolute is co-ordinate with Paradise, and in all space its presence alone is quiescent.
t010.s3.i5: Space potency, the energy not yet responsive to Paradise gravity, derives from the Unqualified Absolute.
t010.s4.i1: The Universal Absolute unifies the deified and the undeified and correlates the absolute and the relative.
t010.s4.i3: This is possible because the Universal Absolute equalizes the tensions between time and eternity, finity and infinity, man and God.
t010.s4.i4: The difference in infinite potential between the Unqualified Absolute and the Deity Absolute makes possible the existence of the material universes and of finite personalities in time.
t010.s4.i5: The unpredictable presence functioning alongside the mind circuits is thought to derive in part from the function of the Universal Absolute.
t010.s5.h: The Triunity of Potentiality and Destiny
t010.s5.i1: The association of the three Absolutes is not a trinity but the triunity of potentiality, since not all three are Deity.
t010.s5.i2: The triunity of potentiality correlates all latent energy realities, spiritual, mindal, and cosmic, and it is infinite in potentiality.
t010.s5.i3: Potentials may partly fail of realization in time, but they do not fail in totality, and the will of God does ultimately prevail.
t010.s5.i4: Within the three Absolutes there always remain unknown possibilities that no experiential development can ever exhaust.
t010.s5.i6: The Absolutes are not a pantheistic impersonal deity; in all that concerns universe personality they are strictly Trinity-limited and Deity-dominated.
